Alger, 14 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) — Le: Algiers, August 14, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The People's National Assembly is accelerating its digital transformation with a visit by its president to the IT center and a progress review of ongoing projects. The stated objective: modernize working methods and strengthen institutional transparency.
ALGER — La présidente du Conseil populai: ALGIERS — The President of the People's National Assembly, Dr. Khalida Boufdesh, inspected the Council's IT center this Thursday, August 13, 2026. There, she received a comprehensive presentation of its equipment, operating mechanisms, and its central role in securing, processing, and storing the institution's digital data. This visit is part of a comprehensive approach to modernizing management tools.
Réunion stratégique sur la numérisation: Strategic meeting on the digitalization of legislative work
ALGER — Une réunion dédiée à l’évaluatio: ALGIERS — A meeting dedicated to evaluating the progress of the digitalization file was chaired by the President of the National People's Assembly. The main objective: to guarantee the best conditions for representatives in the exercise of their legislative and oversight missions. Dr. Khalida Boufdesh reaffirmed her commitment to the digitalization of the Council's work, aligned with the Algerian national digital transformation strategy — Vision 2030.
Dr Khalida Boufdesh a souligné l’adéquat: Dr. Khalida Boufdesh highlighted the alignment of these initiatives with the directives of the President of the Republic, Mr. Abdelmadjid Tebboune, aimed at generalizing digitalization and strengthening transparency and governance. She recalled that these measures are built around institutional performance and public service efficiency.
Le Président du Conseil a détaillé les p: The President of the Council detailed the ongoing digitization projects, including the current state of the digital system, achievements accomplished, and identified needs for the next steps. Particular attention was paid to system interconnection and the simplification of decision-making pathways, to ensure decision-making based on reliable and accurate data.
Appel à la poursuite des efforts et à l’: Call for continued efforts and innovation
À l’issue de la réunion, Dr Khalida Bouf: At the end of the meeting, Dr. Khalida Boufdesh emphasized the need to continue digitization efforts and adapt working methods to technological developments. She also called for the continuous strengthening of the Council's digital system, whose recent progress was praised, while ensuring its adaptation to the needs of the various institutional structures.
